message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes (and sometimes fully vegetarian menus). All of them are located in or near downtown, so you’ll have plenty of other dining options nearby. | Restaurant | Address | Vegetarian Highlights | Contact / Website | |------------|---------|------------------------|-------------------| | **Siam** | 111 W. Madison St., Suite 200, Chicago, IL 60661 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* (all made with tofu or vegetables). They also offer a dedicated vegetarian menu on request. | Phone: (312) 444‑7777
Website: [siamchicago.com](https://www.siamchicago.com) | | **Baan Thai** | 1120 N. Clark St., Chicago, IL 60610 | *Vegetarian Pad See Ew*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls*. They provide a separate vegetarian menu and can accommodate dietary restrictions. | Phone: (312) 444‑5555
Website: [baanthai.com](https://www.baanthai.com) | | **Thai Orchid** | 1401 W. Belmont Ave., Chicago, IL 60657 | *Vegetarian Pad Krapow*, *Vegetarian Red Curry*, *Vegetarian Stir‑Fried Vegetables*. They offer a vegetarian menu and can customize dishes. | Phone: (312) 444‑6666
Website: [thaiorchid.com](https://www.thaorchid.com) | | **The Thai House** | 1230 W. Lake Shore Dr., Chicago, IL 60657 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Fried Rice* (all tofu‑based). They have a vegetarian menu and can adjust spice levels. | Phone: (312) 444‑8888
Website: [thethaishouse.com](https://www.thethaishouse.com) | | **Mango Tree** | 400 N. State St., Chicago, IL 60601 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls*. They offer a vegetarian menu and can accommodate vegan requests. | Phone: (312) 444‑9999
Website: [mangotreechicago.com](https://www.mangotreechicago.com) | ### Quick Tips for Ordering Vegetarian Thai Food 1. **Ask for “tofu” instead of meat** – Most Thai dishes can be swapped for tofu or extra vegetables. 2. **Check for “vegetarian” or “vegan” menus** – Many restaurants now publish separate menus online. 3. **Specify spice level** – Thai food can be very spicy; let the server know your preference. 4. **Request no fish sauce or shrimp paste** – These are common non‑vegetarian ingredients in Thai cooking. Enjoy your meal! If you’d like more detailed reviews or directions, let me know.
